title: Sidney Sheldon's novel about a crashed saucer seen by a tour bus

tellings.quote: He too wouldn't dare ever be public about it. So he wrote this book called The Doomsday Project, you know, a hypothetical

plain: The bestselling novelist Sidney Sheldon is said to have known something about real UFOs but never dared to say so publicly, so he wrote a novel, which the teller calls The Doomsday Project, about a crashed saucer in Italy seen by the passengers of a tour bus. The lawyer Dan Sheehan tells this, passing on what he heard through the television producers Bill Todman Jr. and Bill Todman Sr., and calls the book "a hypothetical." If so, the novel would be a true story dressed up as fiction.
